resources.string: A valid battery-level is shown as a percentage. Missing data stays unknown; battery bars are not converted.
Close the paper tray cover. This does not indicate whether paper is present.
No photo paper detected. Load or reseat the paper, then resume this job.
Paper jam or pickup fault. Power the printer off and on, and wait for automatic ejection. Do not create another job.
Remove the printed photo, then resume.
Check and reseat the photo paper, then resume.
Ribbon exhausted. Replace the ribbon and check the paper supply, then resume.
Install or reseat the ribbon, then resume the existing job.
Ribbon stuck or abnormal. Restart and reseat the ribbon; replace it if the fault persists.
Temperature outside the operating range. Wait for automatic recovery or cancel.
Battery is low. Connect external power; do not infer a percentage from this warning.
Unrecognized printer fault. Check the official app; automatic recovery is disabled.
Queue paused: a printer outcome is unconfirmed. Do not blindly retry or remove this job.

Inspect the printer and any printed sheet first. This checks that the printer is idle and releases queued jobs, but does NOT retry or mark the uncertain job successful. Retrying that old job may print a duplicate.
I checked - query and continue queue
